title: OpenDDE & VERITAS: The Open-Source AI Catalysts Revolutionizing Science (and How They Work)
angle: Demystify how OpenDDE's biomolecular foundation model is accelerating drug discovery and VERITAS is automating scientific research replication, breaking down the underlying AI mechanisms that are bringing unprecedented speed and rigor to scientific endeavors.
rationale: These two stories together represent a significant leap in AI's capacity to transform scientific research, warranting an explanation of their core mechanisms.
